tasks.title: Wire the envlint CLI and its process tests

acceptance_criteria.text: `bin/envlint.mjs` starts with `#!/usr/bin/env node` and `node --test` exits 0 (covers: REQ-26)
`envlint --schema s.json e.env` reads exactly those two fixture files (covers: REQ-1, REQ-8)
run in a temp dir holding its own `.env`, pointed at a fixture elsewhere, only the fixture's problems are reported and the dir listing is unchanged afterwards (covers: REQ-9, REQ-28, REQ-30)

env `PORT=abc\nJUNK` with schema `{"PORT":{"type":"int"},"DB":{"required":true}}` prints `<f>:1: PORT: expected int, got "abc"`, `<f>:2: expected KEY=value`, `<f>: DB: required key is missing` and exits 1 (covers: REQ-2, REQ-3)
a valid env file satisfying its schema exits 0 with empty stdout and stderr (covers: REQ-3)
no args, only `--schema s.json`, or only an env path → exit 2 with the usage line on stderr (covers: REQ-26)
a missing env file → exit 2, stderr names the path, no `    at ` stack frame (covers: REQ-4)
a missing schema, a schema `{not json`, and a schema `{"A":{"type":"float"}}` → exit 2, stderr names the schema, no stack frame (covers: REQ-5)
a binary-garbage env file with a valid schema exits 1 or 0 with no stack frame (covers: REQ-7)
stdout of a findings run contains no `\x1b[` and the process exits with stdin left open and unused (covers: REQ-31)
an empty env file with a one-required-key schema exits 1 with the missing-key line; with a schema of no required keys it exits 0 (covers: REQ-6)
